The Loyalty Card Transaction Request contains three data sections: 
• Data Section No. 1 
 Data Section No. 1 contains the following data elements: 
 Message Format Version Identifier (Element No. 55) 
 Number of Segments (Element No. 63) 
 Please refer to chapter 13, “Data Element Descriptions,” for additional information about 
these data elements. 
• Data Section No. 2 
 Data Section No. 2 contains the following data segment: 
 Standard Message Data Segment (Data Segment No. 100) 
 Please refer to chapter 12, “Data Segment Formats,” for additional information about this 
data segment. 
• Data Section No. 3 
 Data Section No. 3 contains none, one, or more of the following data segments: 
 Data Segment No. 108, Loyalty Card Data Segment 
 Data Segment No. 114, SKU Data Segment 
 Please refer to chapter 12, “Data Segment Formats,” for additional information about these 
data segments.

This field contains the account status received from the 
First Data Auth Optimizer. 
 
Valid Values: 
A = New Acct # & Exp Date  
E = New Exp Date 
Q = Contact Cardholder 
C = Closed 
U = Unknown Card 
 
Note: 
This field is included in the response only when the merchant 
has sent the Account Updater Request Indicator field 
(Variable Information segment 111 Table ID 060 Sub table ID 
01) with the value of “Y” or “I” in the transaction request. 
 
Note: This field is applicable only to Visa and MasterCard.
